BiblicalUsage: Helem is the same man as Heldai, named among those who bring gold from Babylon for the crown of Joshua, and the crowns are kept in the temple as a memorial to Helem and Tobijah and Jedaiah and Hen. His name is on the memorial.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps the givers' names on the crown: Helem's gift is remembered in the temple, and the memorial is still there.
